pauseOnRestart.title: Pause after bridge restart
pauseOnRestart.description: Off: active rules continue after fresh readings and equipment checks. Paused rules stay paused. On: require Resume after every restart.

homeKitRoomTemperature.title: Show climate rule temperature in Apple Home
homeKitRoomTemperature.description: While a temperature rule controls this thermostat, show the selected-sensor temperature and desired room target in its Apple Home tile. Apple Home target changes set the desired room temperature directly. Otherwise show Nest's actual temperature and target. Physical Nest and Google app controls still use the rule's manual-change setting.

heatingType.title: Heating type
heatingType.description: For Heating response & tuning in the web dashboard. Selecting a type does not change rule settings.

heatingResponseEnabled.title: Observe heating response locally
heatingResponseEnabled.description: Record room temperatures, Nest targets and heating state for rule recommendations. Apply each suggestion explicitly in the web dashboard. Turning this off clears this thermostat’s response history.

scheduleTimeZone.title: Nest schedule time zone
scheduleTimeZone.description: Leave blank to use the time zone reported by Nest for the thermostat or its home. Choose a named IANA zone such as America/Los_Angeles to override it. The custom Settings page provides a time-zone picker.

dashboardTemperatureUnit.title: Dashboard temperature units
dashboardTemperatureUnit.description: Celsius or Fahrenheit for dashboard readings, targets and rule limits. Does not change the thermostat display setting.

climateRuleDrafts.title: Climate automation rules
climateRuleDrafts.description: Manage named rules in the standalone dashboard. Rules run only when enabled. Heating groups use bounded target adjustments; room fans and combined presence use selected Homebridge inputs.

desiredTemperature.description: Stored in Celsius (temperature differences also use Celsius). Use the climate rule editor for Fahrenheit input.

maximumOffset.description: Stored in Celsius (temperature differences also use Celsius). Use the climate rule editor for Fahrenheit input.

window.title: Scheduled window (omit for Always)
window.description: All day, every day when omitted. Start days refer to the day a window opens; an earlier end time is the following day.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Higher numbers take priority. Enabled groups sharing a thermostat need different priorities.

threshold.description: Stored in Celsius (temperature differences also use Celsius). Use the climate rule editor for Fahrenheit input.

hysteresis.description: Stored in Celsius (temperature differences also use Celsius). Use the climate rule editor for Fahrenheit input.

startGap.description: Stored in Celsius (temperature differences also use Celsius). Use the climate rule editor for Fahrenheit input.

stopGap.description: Stored in Celsius (temperature differences also use Celsius). Use the climate rule editor for Fahrenheit input.

fullSpeedGap.description: Stored in Celsius (temperature differences also use Celsius). Use the climate rule editor for Fahrenheit input.

window.title: Scheduled window (omit for Always)
window.description: All day, every day when omitted. Start days refer to the day a window opens; an earlier end time is the following day.

host.title: Listen address
host.description: Direct HTTP/HTTPS listen address. Reverse proxy mode always binds to 127.0.0.1 and accepts only the local proxy.

certificatePath.title: TLS certificate file
certificatePath.description: Used only for direct HTTPS. Not read or generated in HTTP or reverse proxy mode.

keyPath.title: TLS private key file
keyPath.description: Used only for direct HTTPS. Not read or generated in HTTP or reverse proxy mode.

protocol.title: Connection mode
protocol.description: Choose direct HTTPS with certificates in the plugin, direct HTTP (passwords and data travel unencrypted), or HTTPS through a proxy on the same machine. The proxy handles certificates and the HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect.

publicOrigin.title: Public HTTPS origin
publicOrigin.description: Required in reverse proxy mode, for example https://climate.example.com. No path, query or credentials. The public port is optional; the backend port is separate.

layout.title: Accounts
layout.description: One or more accounts to connect to Google/Nest services. See plugin documentation for details on obtaining required credentials for each account type.

layout.title: Home Settings
layout.description: Add and configure settings for specific Nest or Google homes.

items.title: Homes
items.description: Each entry applies to a home. The name must match the home name in the Nest or Google Home apps.

items.title: Home Name
items.placeholder: Must match the home name in the Nest or Google Home apps

layout.title: Device Settings
layout.description: Configure global device settings or override them for specific devices.

items.title: Enable Eve History for All Devices
Device Overrides
items.description: Per-device settings. The climate Settings page provides detected devices, temperature units and heating recommendations.

items.title: Show climate rule temperature in Apple Home
Fan preset switches in Apple Home
Enable Support Dump Logging
items.description: Enable detailed device data logging for troubleshooting. Only enable when requested as it may produce large logs.

layout.title: Web dashboard
layout.description: Choose direct HTTP, direct HTTPS, or HTTPS through a local reverse proxy. Create the separate web account in the custom settings page.

layout.title: Advanced rule configuration
layout.description: Use the climate rule editor for discovered sensors, drag ordering, help and execution status. These fields allow offline configuration using source IDs. All temperature values here use Celsius. Save and restart the child bridge when editing this form.
